title: UNBOXING The Winspace T1600.

takeaways.text: The owner waited about 11 weeks for a complete Dura-Ace bike bought on a promotion at about US$5,500 (July 2026); it arrived largely assembled with Hyper D67 wheels, a multi-tool kit and Michelin Power Cup tires.

disclosure: The owner explains the complete bike was bought at clearance before the T1600 Ultra launch; the description mentions no sponsorship.
summary: Unboxing of a nearly fully assembled Dura-Ace T1600 complete bike in Deep Space with Lún Hyper D67 wheels, showing packaging and what remains to assemble.
